envelope.description: Delegate the run-file guard for managed children

body.title: Delegate the run-file guard for managed children
body.summary: Have the supervisor own the existing guard and issue generation-scoped grants for child startup and listener close. Capture partial publication and reconcile only identity-proven files before releasing the guard.
acceptanceChecks: Forced close and partial startup release the supervisor-owned guard only after verified reap and reconciliation
Foreign or orphan guard and legacy Linux behavior remain fail-closed

tests.name: Guarded stale run files and replacement ownership
Run-file mutation rejects a mismatched grant, channel or generation
Partially published run files stay fenced while startup reap is unconfirmed
Repeated or stale lease release cannot change the physical run-file guard
Queued release before and after escalation preserves shutdown guard
Kill startup child before PID, after PID, and after socket publication before ready
